data.name: Artemis CP/M-80 backward-compatibility expansion module

specification.expansion_role: Z80 executes qualified Aurelia/CP/M binaries in a separate guest environment; the new host processor does not execute them natively.

data.compatibility_note: Runs Z80 binaries through the peripheral bridge; distinct from recompiling to native ERA. Bridge capability queries must reflect the emulated CP/M environment, not expose unavailable ERA facilities.
manufacturing_requirements: Choose eight 64K×1 data DRAMs as a candidate, or another explicitly costed organization

add refresh, ROM or host-upload boot logic, mailbox RAM/window and arbitration (dual-port is not mandatory), bus transceivers/width conversion, doorbells, clock/reset, mapper emulation, connector and diagnostics. Count its RAM separately from system modules. PRO compatibility is not currently promised.

public_roadmap.status_at_announcement: Planned separately sold Z80 legacy option; host architecture and word size undisclosed.
public_roadmap.scope: Qualified documented-interface applications only; no extension of compatibility to Artemis PRO or all future models.
